title: Translation materials
description: Organize context, terminology and reviewed translations for backup and sharing.

exchange.title: Backup & sharing
exchange.help: Review imported content and scope. Export files for others or an external AI agent to maintain.

editor.entry_help: Saving does not approve an entry. Check its translation, sources and scope before approval.
editor.expression_help: Explains expressions present in the source; never adds mannerisms to other lines.
editor.memory_help: Reviewed translations provide examples and never directly replace new output.
editor.scope_help: Organization is separate from scope. Select required subjects and roles below; all conditions must match.
editor.source_existing: Leave blank to keep existing sources; a note adds a source record.
editor.source_default: If blank, the entered content is recorded as a manual source.
editor.adopt: I checked the content and scope; approve this entry on save
editor.language_defaults: Language defaults apply to new entries only.
editor.style_help: A style must reference at least one rule. Create rules in Materials first.
editor.suggestion_help: Roles are suggestions; each translation still needs its own content and speaker scope confirmation.
editor.archive_help: Archiving preserves content and history. Edit again to restore it.
editor.create_collection_first: Create a collection first, then add terms or context.
editor.expression_scope: Expressions about a person require that person's speaker role. Confirm it under scope.
editor.language_change: Changing languages clears incompatible style or rule selections.
editor.dependencies: Saving includes collections required by the selected styles.

plans.notice: Prepare, maintain and share plans and styles here. They are not yet connected to subtitle translation tasks.

empty.materials: Start with a few terms and context notes
empty.materials_help: Create a collection and add entries, or import a prepared knowledge file.
empty.filtered: No materials match. Adjust filters or search terms.
empty.plans_help: Prepare translation rules, then create styles or material plans.

scope.general_help: No specific subject required within the given language pair.

detail.revision: Revision {{revision}} · Saving edits creates a new revision

success.reject: Suggestion rejected. It remains in all materials.

import.title: Review import
import.trust_help: External files cannot approve entries for you. Imports await review; conflicts keep your local version by default.
import.warning_generic: Some material needs attention. Check its content and scope before importing.
import.same_revision: Same revision, different content. Keep local or create a copy; replacement is unavailable.
import.adopt_ready: I checked the {{count}} entries marked ready. Approve selected versions on import; candidates still require review.

export.title: Export knowledge file
export.description: Save an importable knowledge file for backup, sharing or further editing.
export.share_help: Export locally approved, ready entries from selected collections with required dependencies.
export.backup_help: Includes all candidates, archives, reviewed translations, plans, styles and preferences. Excludes subtitle files and model keys.
export.memories: Include reviewed translations and required source excerpts
export.memories_help: Reviewed translations may contain full dialogue or personal content. Check suitability before including them.
export.backup_memories: A full backup includes all reviewed translations and required source excerpts.

errors.unexpected: The operation failed. Your input is preserved; please retry.
errors.required: Fill in required fields and check selected materials and languages.
errors.invalid_input: The format or references are invalid. Check the content and retry.
errors.access_denied: Cannot access this file or material. Select it again.
errors.storage_unavailable: Materials are unavailable. Refresh and retry.
errors.revision_conflict: Materials changed. Close and reopen this item, review the latest content, then save.
errors.plan_expired: This import preview expired. Close it and select the file again.
errors.import_conflict: Import choices have conflicting references. Adjust them or preview again.
errors.not_found: Material not found. Refresh and retry.
errors.write_failed: Saving failed; existing materials are preserved. Check disk space and retry.
errors.limit_exceeded: Materials exceed size or count limits. Split them and retry.
errors.file_exists: This file already exists. Choose another name.
errors.unsupported_destination: This location cannot safely create the knowledge file. Save to a writable local folder, then copy it to your backup drive.

diagnostic.CONFLICT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Conflicting identities require review after import.
diagnostic.LANGUAGE_TAG: Use explicit language tags, such as ja, en, zh-Hans or zh-Hant.
diagnostic.SPEAKER_NOT_PERSON: A speaker must be a person.
diagnostic.EXPRESSION_SPEAKER_REQUIRED: A person's expression requires their speaker scope.
diagnostic.KEEP_SOURCE_TARGET: When keeping source, target text must equal source text.
diagnostic.REQUIRED_ADVISORY: Required rules need confirmation for scenario conditions.
diagnostic.RECIPE_STYLE_COLLECTION: The plan is missing a collection required by its styles.
diagnostic.RECIPE_LEARNING_DESTINATION: Select a destination collection for reviewed translations.
diagnostic.DERIVATION_REVISION_CHANGED: Derivation uses an older revision; review its excerpt.
diagnostic.MEMORY_ALIGNMENT_REVIEW: Confirm the translation and source segment were human reviewed.
diagnostic.AI_PROPOSAL_READY: An AI proposal cannot approve itself; review the content.
diagnostic.STYLE_NOT_READY: A style's rule or related material is not ready.
diagnostic.RECIPE_STYLE_ARCHIVED: The plan contains an archived style.
diagnostic.TERM_TRANSLATION_CONFLICT: A term has competing translations; check scope and sources.

languages.custom_help: Use an explicit language tag such as it, vi or zh-Hans; automatic detection is not supported.
languages.invalid: Enter a canonical language tag; Chinese requires zh-Hans or zh-Hant.
